question: f(x) = \int \frac{x}{x^{2}+1} \, dx
hint: Substitution: u = x²+1 ger du = 2x dx.

question: f(x) = \int \tan(x) \, dx

question: f(x) = \int \frac{\ln(x)^{2}}{x} \, dx
